metadata.description: Pointer-only plugin marketplace: every entry's source lives in another repo.

plugins.name: custom-compaction
plugins.description: Replaces Claude Code's built-in compaction with a configurable summarizer (the session's model or any OpenAI/Anthropic-format endpoint).

plugins.name: github-ninja
plugins.description: GitHub know-how for coding agents: the gh CLI and API, issues, commits and rebases, CI failure diagnosis, GitHub Actions hardening and efficiency, repo security audits, Dependabot, secret scanning, CodeQL and more.

plugins.name: docshelf-plugin
plugins.description: Offline, version-pinned documentation for coding agents: search and read DevDocs documentation and Dash/Zeal docsets with your own notes (CLI or MCP server), and build trimmed docvols from Sphinx, Doxygen and llms.txt sites.
